definition_en: The ability to understand customer needs, provide helpful and responsive support, and ensure positive experiences for clients or users.
definition_ms: Keupayaan untuk memahami keperluan pelanggan, memberi sokongan yang membantu dan responsif, serta memastikan pengalaman positif untuk pelanggan atau pengguna.
typical_tasks_en:
• Greet walk-in customers warmly and guide them to the right counter.
• Anticipate that a regular client might need early check-in and arrange it in advance.
• Resolve a guest's complaint about room cleanliness by offering a prompt solution.
typical_tasks_ms:
• Sapa pelanggan yang masuk dengan mesra dan tunjukkan mereka ke kaunter yang betul.
• Jangka bahawa pelanggan tetap mungkin memerlukan daftar masuk awal dan aturkan terlebih dahulu.
• Selesaikan aduan tetamu tentang kebersihan bilik dengan menawarkan penyelesaian segera.
inclusion_rules:
• The task involves directly assisting customers or clients
• The task requires anticipating customer needs and proactively helping
• The task involves resolving customer complaints or issues
• The task requires maintaining positive customer relationships
• The task involves gathering customer feedback to improve service
exclusion_rules:
• The task involves internal operations with no customer interaction
• The user performs back-end work invisible to customers
• The task requires no understanding of customer needs or satisfaction
• The user only processes requests mechanically without service mindset
insufficient_context_rule: Return insufficient_context=true when the task is internal or back-end with no customer interaction or service intent.

confusions.boundary_rule: Service orientation is about helpful action. Empathy is emotional understanding.
confusions.example_task: Understand a customer's frustration and proactively offer a solution.
confusions.expected_labels: Service orientation and customer service; Empathy and active listening

confusions.boundary_rule: Service supports existing customers. Marketing attracts new customers.
confusions.example_task: Follow up with satisfied customers to encourage referrals.
confusions.expected_labels: Service orientation and customer service; Marketing and media

confusions.boundary_rule: Service may involve explaining, but teaching is structured skill development.
confusions.example_task: Teach a customer how to use the self-service portal.
confusions.expected_labels: Teaching and mentoring; Service orientation and customer service
